title: SOLO & MUTE GROUPS
author: irpina
description: Solo and four mute groups for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, on the stock global mutes (FUNC + a track key). Hold PAGE and press a track key: that track plays alone among its four (the synth tracks, or the MIDI tracks); the same again gives the mutes back as they were. MUTE GROUPS in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) stores the mutes of all eight tracks as group 1-4 and recalls them, saved with the project; SOLO there solos the held track. OS 1.43 and 1.44 (it names no firmware address: its 1.44 port is empty). Needs core-dn1 5.0.1.
